purpose: A real concurrency architecture board inside one named frame on a tinted view background, with Excalifont (family 5) text throughout, rounded rectangles, ellipses, a diamond, labelled bound arrows and a cross-hatch fill, complementing Velox's white-background Comic Shanns coverage.

sanitization.review_notes: Retain upstream bytes verbatim. The 42 text elements are technical labels for the varmq queue/worker architecture (including the upstream typos 'peneding' and 'Architechture', kept verbatim); there are no embedded assets. appState contains grid controls and the #fffce8 view background only. Reuses the pool content review in tests/public-scenes/README.md; promotion sign-off remains pending. No rendering-affecting fields or original number tokens were rewritten.

applicability.frame_exports: Deferred: this intake proposes whole-scene exports only, where the single frame renders with clip, name and outline on and bounds every other element. Single-frame export variants require a frame-target intake extension.
applicability.assets: Not applicable: files is empty and there are no image elements. The approved Stage-4 representative supplies complementary nested-SVG and raster coverage.
applicability.sizing: Propose scale 0.5 with default padding for both modes. At scale one the native PNG requires a 6524x5993 surface (39098332 pixels) and fails with resource.raster-surface-exceeded against the default max_raster_surface_pixels 33554432; that deliberate resource outcome needs its own reviewed variant and is not proposed here.
